environment: Native Chrome, local production build at http://127.0.0.1:3017; API8017. Not deployed.
before: Meta+K in Verify opened both the workspace and global command palettes.
Closing a palette opened from Your machines navigated to Verify instead of preserving the workspace.
A letter shortcut on a focused command button navigated the underlying workspace while the modal was open.
Shift+Tab to Keyboard shortcuts followed by Enter opened Design Studio because the container intercepted button Enter and ran its highlighted command.
fix: One global chord handler delegates to the existing Verify trigger. Explicit global search remains available.
Keep palette open state separate from the workspace screen. Reuse the installed shared Radix Dialog for modal focus, Escape and return focus.
Ignore prevented/modal key events in workspace letter shortcuts.
Keep custom Arrow/Enter selection on the search input; native buttons activate their own command.
native_pass: Meta+K and Control+K open exactly one named Verify dialog with search focus.
Control+K closes the local dialog and returns focus to Open Verify command palette without leaving Your machines.
Escape from a focused command returns focus and retains Your machines; h inside the modal does not navigate the underlying workspace.
Shift+Tab stays within the palette; Enter on Keyboard shortcuts opens that sheet over Your machines.
An unmatched query plus ArrowDown and Enter causes no navigation. Mixed-case TrIaGe plus Enter opens Triage at scale.
Outside Verify, Control+K opens the global Command palette; Escape returns focus to Search and jump to a workspace and retains Design Studio.
check_note: An immediate focus assertion observed BODY during Radix unmount. A fresh settled UI observation confirmed correct trigger focus; no speculative focus workaround was added. One exact-label selector omitted DOM-adjacent text spacing, was corrected from observed DOM, and passed.
limits: Local menu behavior only. This does not certify every command destination, broader responsive/shortcuts-sheet behavior, production, external integrations, or general result accuracy.
